notes: u32 generator state: seed * 3877 + 29573 stays below 2^30, so no overflow.
Linear scan over a cumulative []f64; f64(seed) / f64(im) is a plain IEEE division.
ALU lines are slices of the bytes of alu + alu[..60] (array slices share memory), so a line never wraps mid-copy.
Lines collect in a 64 KiB strings.Builder written to os.stdout() per chunk (V leaves C's stdout unbuffered); v -prod static binary on a scratch image.
